title: Area forecast discussion (NWS)
description: An NWS area forecast discussion: the forecaster's reasoning by time period, with an aviation section. Exercise product: the template adds an exercise banner. Real NWS office, center and station identifiers; the county, places and people are fictional.

sections.description: Sections with a heading and text

heading.description: Section heading as in the product (SYNOPSIS, NEAR TERM...)

examples: A cold front will cross the area tonight with a line of showers and thunderstorms, some of which could be severe. Much cooler air arrives Thursday.

examples.heading: SYNOPSIS
examples.text: A cold front will cross the area tonight with a line of showers and thunderstorms, some of which could be severe. Much cooler air arrives Thursday.

examples.heading: NEAR TERM /THROUGH TONIGHT/
examples.text: Scattered storms are developing ahead of the front. Damaging winds and a few tornadoes are the main threats through 9 PM before storms exit east after midnight.

examples.heading: SHORT TERM /THURSDAY THROUGH FRIDAY/
examples.text: Gusty northwest winds and cooler temperatures follow the front. Highs on Thursday will only reach the lower 50s.

examples.heading: AVIATION /19Z WEDNESDAY THROUGH 18Z THURSDAY/
examples.text: Thunderstorms with brief IFR visibility are expected at all terminals between 21Z and 02Z, then MVFR ceilings improve to VFR by morning.
